title: Trip distribution
caption: The original heatmap contains 11 effective OD-zone indices, using the sorted union of origin and destination IDs. Colors show log(1 + person trips) for 11:00–12:00 HBO_LOCAL_ACTIVITY. The zone-index table preserves all 11 modeled zones; absent OD cells remain zero, and unassigned intrazonal and unreachable movements are not imputed. Single-pass engineering scenario; no local empirical calibration.
